name: Rollmark
author: dev-du-futur
description: Roll numbers and read their luck. Each roll can grow digits, turn negative or get decimals; its patterns earn badges worth EP, and its total sets a tier from Trash to Transcendent. Spend EP at Glim's shop on luck and rarity potions and number items. Bulk rolls, a badge book, records, saved progress. Inspired by RNGidle.
